preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 150000.
The number of monsters n in each test case must be between 2 and 300000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**12 and 1 <= b_i <= 10**12 for a_i, b_i in monsters)
preconditions.description: Each monster's health a_i and damage b_i must be between 1 and 10^12.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of bullets required to kill all monsters.
